title: Working web apps
note: Vals Vibe Code Bench v1.1. OpenHands. DeepSeek/Grok high; Astra/Sol max. Functionality, not visual taste.

title: Business workflows
note: AutomationBench-AA. Tasks with guardrail violations score zero. This is not the full-task pass rate. Small gaps are not decisive.

title: Long documents
note: AA-LCR v1.1 covers 10K–100K tokens. This does not prove perfect recall across 1M tokens.

title: Office deliverables
note: GDPval-AA v2. Blind pairwise comparisons. Elo is a rating, not a percentage of intelligence.

title: Difficult coding
note: Terminal-Bench v4.0. Astra has a substantial lead in this comparison.

title: Complex PDFs
note: GDP.pdf. A stricter task than summarising a PDF. A text-only document test is a separate condition.

title: Expert questions
note: Humanity’s Last Exam. The stronger reasoning models retain an advantage here.

title: Factual reliability
note: AA-Omniscience ranges from −100 to +100. This score is not an everyday hallucination percentage.
